name: tomload
description: Loading states, decoded: glyph skeletons, ASCII mascots and a decode-in reveal for any DOM element. Zero dependencies. By Tomdesign.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --outfile=dist/tomload.js && esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=iife --global-name=TomLoad --minify --outfile=dist/tomload.iife.js && cp dist/tomload.iife.js docs/tomload.iife.js

author: Johnny Bui — Tomdesign (https://tomdesign.vn)
